title: Input schema for Pry LLM Corpus Builder
description: Build clean, LLM-ready text corpora from any website. Crawls a domain through 12-tier anti-bot bypass and emits deduplicated markdown documents structured for RAG pipelines and fine-tuning datasets. The dataset drops straight into LangChain, LlamaIndex or your vector store.

urls.title: Target URLs
urls.description: One or more https:// URLs to process.

max_pages.title: Max pages
max_pages.description: Hard cap on processed pages (runaway protection).

min_content_chars.title: Min content length (chars)
min_content_chars.description: Skip pages shorter than this - filters nav/boilerplate shells.

dedupe.title: Near-duplicate removal
dedupe.description: SimHash-based near-duplicate filtering across the corpus.

max_items.title: Max items (cost cap)
max_items.description: Hard cap on processed items for this run - keeps trial costs predictable. Billing stops when the cap or your spending limit is reached.

proxy_configuration.title: Proxy configuration
proxy_configuration.description: Apify proxy settings passed through to Pry's premium-proxy tier. Leave default to use the platform proxy automatically.
